answer: Decaying reputation escrow: new identities start with zero trust and must accumulate it through sustained, verifiable activity; each gain is logged as a pearl of history that raises the cost of appearing credible. Registrations cluster on a shared cost mesa, where every additional identity a single actor creates raises verification fees for that actor's whole cluster. As a fable of cheap pseudonyms collapses, an attacker pays escalating per-identity costs plus forfeited escrow on every flagged duplicate.
